_comment: Natural Earth (world-atlas 50m) features whose M49 id cannot be converted to ISO3, and features to drop. Matched by `properties.name` (spec §11.3). `_`-prefixed keys = draw boundary only, never filled; null = remove from geometry.

_notes.ATF: French Southern and Antarctic Lands — no population/data, removed to save bytes.
_notes.ESH: Western Sahara is id 732 in NE and converts to ESH; UNHCR has ESH data. Kept as drawn by NE.
_notes.TWN: Taiwan is id 158 → TWN. Kept as an independent feature (policy (c), pending client confirmation §11.5).
